name: The Currency Game: Why a Strong Peso Hurts Exporters
description: Run a Costarian mango exporter through three exchange-rate scenarios — a 20% peso appreciation, a 20% depreciation, and a high-volatility regime — and learn why a strong currency hurts exporters, why depreciation is a transfer not a free lunch, and how to build a defensible hedging policy.
